question: Pila ang bayad sa filing fee ug unsaon pagkwenta sa zoning fee sa Locational Clearance sa CPDO para sa 2-storey nga building?
answer:
Wala akoy nakit-an nga impormasyon bahin sa Citizens' Charter tungkol sa bayad sa filing fee ug unsaon pagkwenta sa zoning fee sa Locational Clearance sa CPDO para sa 2-storey nga building.

However, based on the provided sources, the following are the procedures for the issuance of Locational Clearance (LC) for 2-storey buildings:

1. Issuance of Locational Clearance (LC) for Building Permit based on the Integrated Zoning Ordinance (2019-2028) (for 2-storey and below) [S1]
2. Validation of Occupancy Permit based on the Integrated Zoning Ordinance (2019-2028) (2-Storey Buildings and Below and 1,500 Building Floor Area and Below) [S2]

Unfortunately, the sources do not provide specific information about the filing fees and zoning fees for these procedures. It is recommended to contact the City Planning and Development Office (CPDO) - Zoning Enforcement Division for the most accurate and up-to-date information.

ground_truth: To obtain a Locational Clearance (LC) for Building Permit for structures 2-storeys and below, applicants must submit: 7 complete sets of signed/sealed building plans, certified true copy of title, accomplished building permit form, sketch plan with vicinity map, bill of materials, and notarized deed of sale or contract of lease. Fees consist of: 1) GIS Map Plotting fee of PHP 300.00; 2) Filing fee of PHP 150.00 for agricultural/residential, or PHP 300.00 for commercial/industrial; and 3) Zoning fee equivalent to 1/10 of 1% of the total building cost. Processing turnaround is 4 Days, 2 Hours, and 25 Minutes.
